name: memo-bridge
description: Memo Labs MCP: read-only Mac and VPS observation, project catalogue, coordination of AI work sessions on GitHub Issues, a Mac runner (worktrees, test/build/lint jobs, pull requests), a VPS runner (queued, sandboxed systemd jobs behind the private hub) and an OAuth-protected remote surface for ChatGPT conversations

scripts.build: esbuild server/index.mjs server/runners/job-runner.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outdir=plugin/server/dist --entry-names=[name] --out-extension:.js=.mjs && npm run build:standalone && npm run smoke:standalone && npm run build:personal-remote
scripts.test:hub: node --test tests/hub-auth.test.mjs tests/hub-oidc-http.test.mjs tests/agent-protocol.test.mjs tests/hub-dispatch.test.mjs tests/oidc-resource.test.mjs tests/oidc-verifier.test.mjs tests/public-listener.test.mjs tests/remote-surface.test.mjs tests/remote-boot.test.mjs tests/remote-e2e.test.mjs tests/remote-wire.test.mjs
scripts.test:operator: node --test tests/operator-policy.test.mjs tests/operator-paths.test.mjs tests/operator-signing.test.mjs tests/operator-tools.test.mjs tests/operator-agent.test.mjs tests/operator-remote.test.mjs tests/operator-write.test.mjs tests/operator-exec.test.mjs tests/operator-root.test.mjs tests/operator-approval.test.mjs tests/operator-mac-install.test.mjs tests/operator-root-mac.test.mjs
scripts.test:runner: node --test tests/agent-protocol.test.mjs tests/hub-dispatch.test.mjs tests/runtime-principal.test.mjs tests/credentials.test.mjs tests/github-app.test.mjs tests/worktrees.test.mjs tests/executor-systemd.test.mjs tests/job-queue.test.mjs tests/lease-supervisor.test.mjs tests/job-unit.test.mjs tests/runner-integration.test.mjs tests/release-manifest.test.mjs tests/coordinator-store-contract.test.mjs && pnpm run test:deploy
